<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for a reaction that forms a sulfonamide (S‑N bond) from a sulfonyl chloride and an amine. I will use a representative sulfonamide product SMILES (CCN(S(=O)(=O)C)C) as the target molecule and filter for templates that break a sulfonyl‑chloride group and form a sulfonamide, with an S‑N bond formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCN(S(=O)(=O)C)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl_chloride"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
